question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : • Difference between the position value of first and second letter = 2 • Difference between the position value of second letter and third letter = 4 So, • Option - (1) : TVR
